judged_text: invalid_host? repeats the same unnormalized comparison (SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host), so any case/scheme/www divergence between the setting and the embed_url the blog's template emits makes the retriever refuse the URL. The URL is never imported and the embed page reloads the loading view every 30 seconds indefinitely, re-enqueueing RetrieveTopic jobs that always no-op — a permanent 'Loading Discussion...' widget driven by a one-character configuration mismatch.

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` the check is a strict string equality: `SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host` (and `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` similarly compares `URI(request.referer).host` to the setting). This could indeed reject an otherwise “same site” URL if the blog emits a different but related host (eg `www.` vs apex) or different casing, causing retrieval to never happen and leaving the iframe showing the `loading` view on reload. However, the diff also shows host-matching is an explicit security/allowlist mechanism (single `embeddable_host`), so rejecting `www` vs apex may be intended, and scheme differences don’t affect `.host` at all. The robustness concern is real and diff-grounded, but it’s not clearly a definite defect from the diff alone.
